candidates.title: Webhook secret validation uses non-constant-time string comparison (timing side-channel) and fragile header lookup
candidates.claim_restated: The webhook handler should look up the configured secret header case-insensitively and validate the provided secret using a constant-time comparison (crypto.timingSafeEqual) instead of !==.
candidates.expected_failure: should accept mixed-case CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME and validate secret using timingSafeEqual

candidates.title: Non-atomic findFirst-then-create in webhook can create duplicate app credentials under concurrent requests
Webhook API handler performs credential create/update without restricting HTTP method (missing POST-only guard)
Credential-sync token refresh request omits shared secret/Authorization header
candidates.claim_restated: When refreshing via the credential-sync endpoint, refreshOAuthTokens must include an authentication secret (e.g., Authorization header) rather than sending only userId and appSlug.

candidates.title: Salesforce calendarservice references `prisma` without importing it
candidates.claim_restated: SalesforceCalendarService calls prisma.credential.update during token refresh but crashes because prisma is referenced without being imported.
candidates.expected_failure: SalesforceCalendarService should refresh tokens without ReferenceError (missing prisma import)

candidates.title: Webhook persists decrypted credential keys without validating per-app credential schema
candidates.claim_restated: The webhook handler decrypts and persists credential keys without validating them against the selected app's credential schema, allowing malformed credential payloads to be stored.
candidates.expected_failure: Webhook persists decrypted credential keys without validating per-app credential schema

candidates.title: Webhook updates an arbitrary credential when user has multiple credentials for the same app
candidates.claim_restated: When a user has multiple credentials for the same app, the webhook must not update an arbitrary credential chosen only by userId+appSlug.
candidates.expected_failure: should not overwrite an arbitrary credential when user has multiple credentials for the same app

candidates.title: .env.example suggests wrong-length AES-256 encryption key generation (24 bytes vs required 32)
candidates.claim_restated: .env.example incorrectly recommends generating AES-256 encryption keys with `openssl rand -base64 24` even though the comments state the key must be 32 bytes.
candidates.expected_failure: Expected AES-256 key generation command for CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY to use 32 bytes (openssl rand -base64 32), not 24

candidates.title: Webhook secret header lookup uses raw env header name, breaking auth due to lowercased req.headers keys
candidates.claim_restated: The webhook handler incorrectly indexes req.headers using the raw (possibly mixed-case) env header name and does not normalize string[] header values, causing valid webhook secrets to be rejected with 403.
candidates.expected_failure: Webhook auth should lowercase the env-configured header name (Node lowercases req.headers keys) and normalize string[] header values

candidates.title: Feature-flag constant evaluates to raw encryption-key string instead of boolean, risking secret leakage
Webhook auth fails open when CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset (undefined equals missing header)
candidates.claim_restated: If CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset, the webhook must fail closed instead of authenticating when the webhook-secret header is missing.
candidates.expected_failure: Webhook auth should fail closed when CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset (missing header must not authenticate)

candidates.title: Instance-wide shared webhook secret allows overwriting any user's app credentials (no per-user binding/replay protection)
candidates.claim_restated: The webhook must not allow a caller who knows a single instance-wide secret to create or overwrite credentials for an arbitrary target userId.
candidates.expected_failure: Instance-wide shared webhook secret should NOT authorize overwriting another user's app credentials

candidates.title: parseRefreshTokenResponse throws on schema mismatch and can crash calendar operations when callers don’t catch it
candidates.claim_restated: parseRefreshTokenResponse should not throw when a provider's refresh-token response fails schema validation (e.g., missing `scope`), and instead return a Zod safeParse result with success:false so callers can handle it without crashing.
candidates.expected_failure: parseRefreshTokenResponse should not throw on schema mismatch; it should return { success: false } so callers can branch instead of crashing

candidates.title: Webhook credential sync updates key but does not clear previously set invalid flag
candidates.claim_restated: When the webhook synchronizes credentials for an existing credential record, it should update the key and also clear any previously-set `invalid` flag so the refreshed credential is not left disabled.
candidates.expected_failure: expected "spy" to be called with arguments: [ { where: { id: 999 }, data: { key: { apiKey: 'new-valid-key' }, invalid: false } } ]

candidates.title: Some OAuth integrations refresh via refreshOAuthTokens but persist the raw sync response without parseRefreshTokenResponse normalization
parseRefreshTokenResponse now throws on Zod safeParse failure, turning previously-graceful token refresh degradation into a hard failure
candidates.claim_restated: parseRefreshTokenResponse should not throw when Zod safeParse fails; it should return the safeParse result (success=false) so callers can handle refresh-token degradation gracefully.
candidates.expected_failure: parseRefreshTokenResponse should degrade gracefully (return safeParse failure) instead of throwing on schema mismatch

candidates.file: UNKNOWN (sync-endpoint fetch call site not included in PR #11059 diff; reports provided no file/line refs)

candidates.title: API route default-imports zod, making `z` undefined and crashing on module load
candidates.claim_restated: The API route must not crash during module initialization when zod has no default export, so it should import z as a named export.
candidates.expected_failure: API route should not crash on module load when zod has no default export (must import { z })

candidates.title: Webhook secret check has no rate limiting, enabling unlimited online guessing/brute force
candidates.claim_restated: Repeated invalid webhook secret guesses against the app-credential webhook are not rate-limited, allowing unlimited online brute-force attempts instead of returning a 429 after too many failures.
candidates.expected_failure: CLAIM: Webhook secret check has no rate limiting, enabling unlimited online guessing/brute force

candidates.title: Webhook app-credential sync updates keys but leaves credential type stale
candidates.claim_restated: When an existing credential is synced via the app-credential webhook, the handler updates the key but should also update the credential's type to match current app metadata to avoid leaving a stale discriminator.
candidates.expected_failure: Webhook app-credential sync should refresh credential type to avoid stale discriminator
